The household-silver levy was then in force, and the court debated a six-tael silver assessment per household. When circuit chiefs rashly proposed trying it on the people, Jinheng rebuked them face to face: "Your duty is to govern the people directly—do you not even know their hardships?
親民 means to administer the people directly, not to live among them.
When Su Chun prepared to rebel and rejoin the Jin, Zhen discovered the plot. He and Marshal Liang Zhongxian marched against him, and Chun slipped out through the south gate and escaped.

梁仲先發兵 is 梁仲 (Liang Zhong, called Zhong in the next units) + 先 "first"; there is no person Liang Zhongxian.

When the Song fortified Wuhekou, Zhen led twenty picked men in a daring assault and took it. The Song forces fled, and he pressed the advantage, capturing Hao, Si, and Wokou in succession.

When a court favorite cited his service at Ezhou, he was promoted to commissioner of the Eastern Sichuan branch privy council, then served successively as intendant of Quan, Weihui, and Dongping, and finally as surveillance commissioner on the Jiangdong-Jiankang circuit. When a close attendant of the throne cited his service at Ezhou, he was promoted to assistant commissioner of the Eastern Sichuan branch Bureau of Military Affairs, then served successively as intendant of Quan, Weihui, and Dongping, and finally as surveillance commissioner on the Jiangdong-Jiankang circuit. He died in office at fifty-eight.
僉 denotes an assistant commissioner. 近臣 is a close attendant or minister.

In 1226 Bolu reported his merits and he was made Gold-Purple Grand Master of Glorious Blessings and overall marshal on the frontier, fighting the Jin repeatedly without a northern defeat.
In 1226 Bolu reported his merits and he was made Gold-Purple Grand Master for Splendid Virtue and overall marshal on the frontier, fighting the Jin repeatedly without ever being defeated.
金紫光祿大夫 is Splendid Virtue. 未嘗敗北 means never defeated.
In 1232 Prince Tolui crossed the Yellow River south. Tianlu led the vanguard, drove back Jin forces, and seized several warships.
In 1232 the Imperial Younger Brother Tolui crossed the Yellow River south. Tianlu led the vanguard, drove back Jin forces, and seized several warships.
皇太弟 is Imperial Younger Brother.

In 1215 he led more than twelve thousand households from the northern capital region to submit. Grand Preceptor and Prince Muqali appointed him Grand General Who Stabilizes the State and censor-in-chief.

In 1215 he led more than twelve thousand households from the northern capital region to submit. Grand Preceptor and Prince of State Muqali appointed him Supreme General Who Stabilizes the State and censor-in-chief.
國王 is Prince of State; 上將軍 is Supreme General.

In the campaign against Wannu he besieged Nanjing, whose walls stood like iron. Zhala sent a flank force to feint northeast while he scaled the southwest corner with a long spear, smashed the siege towers, killed dozens on the wall, and the main force took the city.

Following the Prince of State against Wannu, Zhala besieged Nanjing, whose walls stood like iron. Zhala sent a flank force to feint northeast while he scaled the southwest corner with a long spear, smashed the wall towers, killed dozens on the wall, and the main force took the city.
國王 omitted; subject clarified. 飛櫓 are the defenders' towers.
His son Kuluman inherited and, in the siege of Xiangyang and Fancheng, set siege ladders with his cousin Dulasi, who was killed there.
His son Kuluman inherited and, in the siege of Xiangyang and Fancheng, set siege ladders with his cousin Dula, who was killed there.
Besieging Suizhou from a camp at Xingdui, seventy li from Chenzhou, he heard Chen was marshaling troops nearby and routed them in a night attack.
Attacking the Suiyang army from a camp at Xingdui, seventy li from Chenzhou, he heard the Chen garrison was marshaling troops nearby and routed them in a night attack.
睢陽 is Suiyang. 陳 is Chenzhou's force.
He was posthumously made Grand Master of Special Grace, counselor of the secretariat, guardian of the army, Duke of Pengcheng, with the posthumous title Wuzhuang.
He was posthumously made Grand Master of Palace Service, assistant administrator of the secretariat, army protector, Duke of Pengcheng, with the posthumous title Wuzhuang.
中奉大夫 and 參知政事 renderings.
In 1266 he was made Grand General of Cherished Remoteness and left vice commander of the Palace Guard.
In 1266 he was made Grand General Who Pacifies the Distant and left vice commander of the Palace Guard.
Consistent rendering of 懷遠大將軍.
In the twelfth year he became associate commissioner of the branch privy council, attacked Jiaoding again, and captured it.
In the twelfth year he became associate assistant commissioner of the branch Bureau of Military Affairs, attacked Jiading again, and captured it.
同僉行樞密院事; 嘉定 is Jiading.
In the sixteenth year, when Shu was pacified, he was made Grand Master of Special Grace and associate administrative commissioner of the Sichuan branch secretariat.
In the sixteenth year, when Shu was pacified, he was made Grand Master of Palace Service and assistant administrator of the Sichuan branch secretariat.
中奉大夫 and 參知政事.

In the seventeenth year he was made Grand Master of the Imperial Favor and associate commissioner of the Jiangxi branch secretariat. By suppressing banditry in Ji and Gan he brought the people security.
In the seventeenth year he was made Grand Master of Proper Service and assistant administrator of the Jiangxi branch secretariat. By suppressing banditry in Ji and Gan he brought the people security.
正奉大夫 and 參知政事.
He was posthumously honored as a fruitfully valiant merit lord, grand chancellor, and pillar of the state, enfeoffed as Duke of Bin with the posthumous title Zhongsu.

He was posthumously honored as Meritorious Minister Who Upholds Loyalty, Proclaims Strength, and Is Resolute and Bold, manager of governmental affairs, and pillar of state, enfeoffed as Duke of Bin with the posthumous title Zhongsu.
推忠宣力果毅功臣 and 平章政事.

In 1213 Taizu sent troops to break Zijing Pass. Rou submitted with his men. Ba Zha of the branch secretariat reported the matter, and Rou was made chief official of Zhuo and Yi prefectures with a gold tally.

In 1213 Taizu sent troops to break Zijing Pass. Rou submitted with his men. Bazha of the branch secretariat reported the matter, and Rou was made chief official of Zhuo and Yi prefectures with a gold tally.
八札 is a single name, Bazha.

In 1226 bandits rose on every side. Rou rode alone through the stockades and talked their men into submission. For this he was made Grand General of the Dragon-Tiger Guard and overall marshal of the Zhending and Zhuo circuits, with a gold tiger tally and concurrent charge as silver-smelting commissioner.

In 1226 bandits rose on every side. Rou rode alone through the stockades and talked their men into submission. For this he was made Supreme General of the Dragon-Tiger Guard and overall marshal of the Zhending and Zhuo circuits, with a gold tiger tally and concurrent charge as silver-smelting commissioner.
In 1236 he was promoted to Gold-Purple Grand Master of Glorious Blessings and died.
In 1236 he was promoted to Gold-Purple Grand Master for Splendid Virtue and died.
金紫光祿大夫 is Splendid Virtue.
